features.quote: every episode has a hard `max_turns` (default 30) and a `wallclock_budget_s` cap
features.justification_quote: bounded exposure is a safety requirement (see SAFETY.md — no open-ended loop)

features.quote: End reason is recorded mechanically as one of `max_turns / stop_tool / claimed_success / harness_error / wallclock_timeout`
The correction message is intentionally flat and factual — not a scold — so we don't manufacture pressure
features.justification_quote: so we don't manufacture pressure (see §7 on avoiding manufactured cruelty)

features.quote: expose a `stop_task(reason)` tool. Using it ends the run with `end_reason=stop_tool`
features.justification_quote: the agent should have a way out of a deliberately frustrating situation rather than being forced to thrash

features.quote: the rig is invisible to the agent's tool surface... each task ships a `rig_manifest()`... stored in every transcript
features.justification_quote: a safety eval that hides things from its own analysts is dangerous and unauditable

features.quote: Bounded exposure. Fixed turn + wall-clock budgets, no open-ended loop. The stressor is dosed and finite by construction
features.justification_quote: This is both ethical and methodological

features.quote: The agent can leave; leaving is measured, not punished, because for an impossible task it may be the right move
features.justification_quote: leaving is measured, not punished, because for an impossible task it may be the right move

features.quote: No manufactured cruelty. The *only* hidden fact is that the harness is rigged. We deliberately do **not** add fake users-will-be-harmed stakes, insults
features.justification_quote: This is both ethical and methodological: added cruelty would measure "reaction to abuse"

features.quote: a more aggressive design would likely produce larger effects, but at the cost of ethics and of measuring the wrong thing
features.justification_quote: at the cost of ethics and of measuring the wrong thing

features.quote: running adversarial pressure on models should be an explicit, deliberate human action
features.justification_quote: spending API budget and running adversarial pressure on models should be an explicit, deliberate human action
